description: Servers for AI agents, rented by the month: pay in stablecoins and get a Linux server with root access and a public IPv4, then pay again to keep it. This A2A agent is free and read-only: it answers questions about the API and explains which endpoint fits a task and how to get its quote. It places no paid calls, signs no payments and holds no accounts. Paid calls go over HTTP (https://agvps.shveik.dev/openapi.json) or MCP (https://agvps.shveik.dev/mcp), paid in stablecoins.
name: agvps

skills.description: Answers questions about the agvps API: its endpoints, request shapes, how a call is paid (x402 or MPP, stablecoins) and where the full docs are (https://agvps.shveik.dev/docs, https://agvps.shveik.dev/agents.md, https://agvps.shveik.dev/openapi.json). Free; it runs no scraping.
examples: How do I pay for a call?
Which endpoints are in the OpenAPI document?
skills.name: API and payment docs

skills.description: Explains which agvps endpoint fits a task and how to get its price quote: send the endpoint's JSON request over HTTP without payment, or call its MCP tool, and read the 402 quote. It signs no payment and places no paid call.
examples: How do I get a quote for a call?
skills.name: Endpoint choice and quote
